description: A water-attuned healer who communes with Shelldrift's restless tides, washing away afflictions with saltwater and pearl-light. The ocean's rhythm is their heartbeat.
icon_hint: flowing teal wave crest encircling a glowing pearl of healing light
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy tidechaser water healer class. Smooth coral and seashell border with small pearls at corners. Deep teal-blue water center with gentle wave patterns and soft glowing pearl light. Small wave crest with glowing pearl at bottom. Color palette: deep ocean blue, healing teal, warm pearl white. No characters, no text.
